div.head: Iud Dei X 20.4
div.ab: quatenus iustitiae tuae non dominetur iniquitas, sed ueritati subdatur falsitas; et ut ceteri hoc uidentes ab incredulitate sua, te miserante liberentur. Qui uiuis et regnas Deus per omnia.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 418 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: so that iniquity may not have dominion over your justice, but falsehood be subjected to truth; and that others seeing this may be freed from their unbelief, by your mercy. Who live and reign, God, for all [ages].
